dedupe_keys.name: brisbane city plan 2014 regional infrastructure corridors and substations overlay high voltage substations powerlines and easements

description: Brisbane City Council publishes the feature classes of the Brisbane City Plan 2014 regional infrastructure corridors and substations overlay (map OM-018.1) as open data, read on 2026-09-26. Three layers concern electricity: high voltage powerline substations (104 polygon features, updated 23 September 2025), high voltage powerlines (1,941 features, updated 29 May 2024) and high voltage easements (17 features), each with category, overlay codes, description, area, length and geometry. The overlay is part of the council's planning scheme, which regulates development near major electricity infrastructure, and the council notes that City Plan is regularly amended. Layers are downloadable as CSV, GeoJSON and shapefile or through the API, free under CC BY 4.0. Caveats: the layers show planning categories and footprints, not voltages or ratings. Simulation uses are city-scale mapping of transmission assets for flood and storm hazard exposure and for network flow sketches of Brisbane's high voltage grid. Related records: data-ga-national-electricity-infrastructure gives the national transmission network.
